text: dsh-search-picker 是面向 DSH 桌面端的网页搜索服务选择器，在侧边栏底部提供搜索菜单，并将选择写入官方 web.searchProvider 设置。它注册 OpenCode Go、Tavily 和 Exa 三种搜索服务，同时可切换 DSH 内置的 DeepSeek Messages 与 Search API。各服务返回统一的搜索来源结果，菜单会显示凭据配置状态。适合需要在 DSH 中按场景更换联网搜索后端的用户；自定义服务需要相应 API Key，并将查询发送至所选服务。

dsh-search-picker adds a DSH desktop sidebar menu for switching web search providers. It registers OpenCode Go, Tavily and Exa, alongside built-in DeepSeek options. The choice is saved in web.searchProvider. Custom services need API keys and receive the query.
想在 DSH 侧边栏快速换一个网页搜索服务。
DSH 能否让我在 DeepSeek 搜索和第三方搜索之间切换？
我想用 Tavily 或 Exa 为 DSH 提供联网搜索。
让 DSH 的搜索查询改走 OpenCode Go。
搜索后端换起来太麻烦，有没有侧栏选择菜单？
希望搜索提供方的选择重启后还能保留。
Let me switch web search providers from the DSH sidebar.
I want to use Tavily or Exa for web searches in DSH.
dsh-search-picker 的功能「搜索服务切换」：侧栏底部的搜索按钮打开引擎菜单，选择后更新 web.searchProvider 设置；当前选择作为宿主设置保存。
dsh-search-picker 的功能「注册第三方搜索后端」：插件向 DSH web 服务注册 OpenCode Go、Tavily 与 Exa，接收查询并返回规范化的来源列表。
dsh-search-picker 的功能「显示凭据可用状态」：菜单查询各搜索服务凭据的配置状态，并将未配置凭据的引擎置灰；选择操作会写入官方搜索设置。
dsh-search-picker 的功能「呈现多引擎搜索结果」：适配器将搜索响应转换为来源 URL、标题、摘要和日期等字段，并为 OpenCode Go 使用原生 web search 工具。
dsh-search-picker 使用自定义搜索服务时需配置对应 API Key；查询发送至 OpenCode Go、Tavily 或 Exa 中所选服务。

**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** bundle plugin that puts a “Search: …” button at the
bottom of the desktop sidebar (right above the Settings row) and switches
`ctx.web`'s search backend with one click.

dsh-search-picker README · Engines：| id | Engine | Credential | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-official` | DeepSeek official Messages | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Built in. Anthropic Messages + `web_search_20250305`; each search consumes model tokens |
| `deepseek-search-api` | DeepSeek official Search API | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Built in. Direct retrieval endpoint; no model tokens |
| `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | Provided by this plugin. Anthropic Messages + `x-opencode-session` header; ≈ $0.01 per search |
| `tavily` | Tavily | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Provided by this plugin; greyed out until a key is configured |
| `exa` | Exa | `EXA_API_KEY` | Provided by this plugin; greyed out until a key is configured |

dsh-search-picker README · Engines：Engines without credentials are greyed out in the menu. Selecting an
unregistered/unavailable provider directly in the settings page makes
`web_search` return an explicit `WEB_PROVIDER_*` error instead of silently
falling back to another engine.

dsh-search-picker README · UI：The button sits at the bottom of the sidebar, right above the Settings row. The
menu is a `position: fixed` popover: its width follows the sidebar content width
(sidebar defaults to 280 px, draggable 264–420 px → menu 240–396 px) and updates
live while dragging, so it is never clipped by the sidebar column's
`overflow: hidden`. When the sidebar collapses to the 56 px icon rail, the menu
pops out at 280 px to the right.

dsh-search-picker README · UI：The menu background is opaque: white in the light theme, dark grey in the dark
theme (`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`, theme-aware), with the official popover
hairline stroke and soft elevation shadow (`--dsw-elevation-panel`). The
official menu material (`--dsw-specific-menu` + `backdrop-filter` blur) is
intentionally not used: that surface is only 58 % opaque and relies on the blur
to look right, so without the blur the sidebar text bleeds through.

dsh-search-picker README · Install (desktop profile)：1. Clone the repo to a fixed location:

```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiaosrm/dsh-search-picker.git D:\tools\dsh-search-picker
   ```

dsh-search-picker README · Install (desktop profile)：2. Edit `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\package.json`
   (POSIX: `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json`):
   - add the dependency `"dsh-search-picker": "file:D:/tools/dsh-search-picker"`;
   - append `"dsh-search-picker"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
3. In `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop`, run `pnpm install`.
4. Fully quit and reopen the DSH desktop app. The loader scans profile bundles
   only at startup, and the client half is read into memory at startup too — so
   a page refresh is not enough after updating the plugin.

dsh-search-picker README · Install (desktop profile)：If the `file:` dependency fails to resolve, copy this directory into
`%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-search-picker` and add the package
name to `dsh.profile.bundles` instead.

dsh-search-picker README · Configuration：The bundle ships a default patch entry (`cordis.patch.yml`). Every field is
optional; omitted fields fall back to the defaults below.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: search-picker
      name: dsh-search-picker
      config:

Override any value by targeting the same entry id from your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-search-picker README · Credentials：This plugin never reads or writes the credentials file directly. At search time
it resolves the credential reference named by `apiKeyEnv` through
`ctx.credentials`, falling back to the process environment. A missing credential
raises `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`, and the message names the referenced
variable.

dsh-search-picker README · Fallback：1. Switch back to `deepseek-official` in the menu (or use the official
   **Plugins › Web search** page).
2. Remove `dsh-search-picker` from the profile `package.json` dependencies and
   from `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install`, restart the desktop app.

dsh-search-picker README · Troubleshooting：- **`deepseek-official` returns 404**: check that neither the profile patch nor
  another plugin overrides `web-search-deepseek.baseURL`. It must stay on the
  built-in default (`https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1`); pointing it at a
  search provider's host breaks the provider.
- **Menu width does not follow the sidebar**: the popover measures its anchor
  with `ResizeObserver`; after profile/bundle changes, restart the desktop app
  to reload the client bundle.

dsh-search-picker README · Testing：```powershell
npm run check                # node --check on all three entry files
npm test                     # node --test test/engines.test.mjs
node test/engines.test.mjs   # single-process fallback
```

The single-process fallback exists for Windows sandboxes that block
child-process pipes (`spawn EPERM`).

dsh-search-picker README · Known limitations：- The engine list in the menu is fixed. If the official providers' `apiKeyEnv`
  is remapped to another credential name, the greyed-out state still checks the
  default reference name.
- Conflicts with plugins that take over `web.searchProvider` at runtime
  (`dsh-free-search`, `dsh-web-search-free`, …). Do not install them together.
- `opencode-go`'s `x-opencode-session` uses a random in-process UUID when the
  current session id is unavailable (the Go relay only needs it to be opaque and
  stable).

dsh-search-picker README · Compatibility：- DSH desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (declared in `package.json` → `dsh.compatibility`).
- Client half targets the `web` platform and injects
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`.

[English](README.md) | **中文**

在 DSH 桌面版侧边栏底部（Settings 行上方）放一个「搜索：…」按钮，一键切换 `ctx.web` 的搜索后端。切换写入的是 **官方 `web` 设置命名空间的 `searchProvider` 字段**，也就是「插件 > 网页搜索」页编辑的同一个字段，因此：

- 切换立即生效，不需要重启；
- 重启后保持（写入宿主 settings 文档）；
- 与官方设置页完全一致，不会互相覆盖。

dsh-search-picker README · 可选引擎：| id | 引擎 | 凭据 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-official` | DeepSeek 官方 Messages | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | 官方内置，Anthropic Messages + `web_search_20250305`，每次搜索消耗模型 token |
| `deepseek-search-api` | DeepSeek 官方 Search API | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | 官方内置，直接检索 API，不烧模型 token |
| `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | 本插件提供；Anthropic Messages + `x-opencode-session` 头；约 $0.01/次 |
| `tavily` | Tavily | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | 本插件提供；未配置 key 时置灰 |
| `exa` | Exa | `EXA_API_KEY` | 本插件提供；未配置 key 时置灰 |
dsh-search-picker README · 可选引擎：未配置凭据的引擎在菜单里置灰；直接在设置里选中未注册/不可用的 provider 时，`web_search` 会返回明确的 `WEB_PROVIDER_*` 错误，不会静默换引擎。

dsh-search-picker README · 界面：按钮固定在侧边栏底部、Settings 行上方。菜单是 `position: fixed` 浮层：宽度跟随侧边栏内容宽度（侧边栏默认 280px、可拖拽 264–420px，对应菜单 240–396px），拖动侧边栏时实时变化，因此不会被侧边栏列的 `overflow: hidden` 裁掉；侧边栏折叠成 56px 图标轨时，菜单以 280px 向右浮出。

菜单背景是不透明的：浅色主题纯白、深色主题深灰（`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`，随主题自动切换），并配官方浮层描边与柔和投影（`--dsw-elevation-panel`，0.5px 描边 + 双层阴影）。官方菜单那套 `--dsw-specific-menu` + `backdrop-filter` 毛玻璃刻意没有沿用——它只有 58% 不透明、必须靠 blur 才成型，缺了模糊就会透出侧边栏文字。

dsh-search-picker README · 安装（desktop profile）：1. 克隆到任意固定位置：

```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiaosrm/dsh-search-picker.git D:\tools\dsh-search-picker
   ```

dsh-search-picker README · 安装（desktop profile）：2. 编辑 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\package.json`（POSIX：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json`）：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-search-picker": "file:D:/tools/dsh-search-picker"`；
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-search-picker"`。
3. 在 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop` 执行 `pnpm install`。
4. 完全退出并重开 DSH 桌面版（loader 只在启动时扫描 profile bundles；客户端 bundle 同样在启动时读入内存，改完插件后刷新页面不够）。

如果 `file:` 依赖解析失败，可把本目录复制到 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-search-picker`，并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中追加包名。

dsh-search-picker README · 配置：插件自带默认 patch 条目（`cordis.patch.yml`），所有字段均可省略，省略即使用内置默认值：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: search-picker
      name: dsh-search-picker
      config:

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按同一个条目 id 覆盖任意字段即可。
dsh-search-picker README · 凭据：本插件不直接读写凭据文件：搜索时通过 `ctx.credentials` 解析 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的凭据引用，找不到时回退到进程环境变量。缺失凭据抛出 `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`，错误信息包含所引用的变量名。

dsh-search-picker README · 回退：1. 在菜单里切回 `deepseek-official`（或使用官方「插件 > 网页搜索」页）；
2. 从 profile `package.json` 删除 `dsh-search-picker` 依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目，`pnpm install`，重启桌面版。

dsh-search-picker README · 排障：- **`deepseek-official` 返回 404**：检查 profile patch 或其它插件是否覆盖了 `web-search-deepseek.baseURL`。它必须保持内置默认值（`https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1`）；指向搜索服务的地址会把这个 provider 弄坏。
- **菜单宽度不跟随侧边栏**：浮层用 `ResizeObserver` 测量锚点；改过 profile/bundle 后重启桌面版以重新加载客户端 bundle。

dsh-search-picker README · 测试：```powershell
npm run check                # 三个入口文件的 node --check
npm test                     # node --test test/engines.test.mjs
node test/engines.test.mjs   # 单进程兜底
```

单进程兜底用于禁止子进程管道的 Windows 沙箱（`spawn EPERM`）。

dsh-search-picker README · 已知限制：- 菜单里的引擎是固定清单；官方两个 provider 的 `apiKeyEnv` 若被改到别的凭据名，置灰判断仍按默认引用名。
- 与 `dsh-free-search` / `dsh-web-search-free` 这类「运行时接管 `web.searchProvider`」的插件冲突，不要同时安装。
- `opencode-go` 的 `x-opencode-session` 在拿不到当前会话 id 时使用进程内随机 UUID（对 Go 中继而言只需不透明且稳定）。

dsh-search-picker README · 兼容性：- DSH 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2`（声明在 `package.json` 的 `dsh.compatibility`）。
- 客户端半区面向 `web` 平台，inject `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`。
